d4e3bf5025.q: What milestones has ReconAfrica achieved at the Kavango West 1X Discovery Well?
d4e3bf5025.a: ReconAfrica and its partners BW Energy and Namco reported that natural gas and potential liquids are flowing to surface from two separate reservoir zones. The uppermost Huttenberg formation flowed hydrocarbons immediately after perforation, while the upper Ilanshok formation had previously demonstrated the ability to flow hydrocarbons to surface. ReconAfrica plans to conduct an open-hole horizontal production test targeting a lateral section of up to 1,000 meters.
